description: This file defines utility functions and flags for managing shared file descriptors, including parsing integer values from strings and setting shared file descriptor objects.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Parses an integer from a string and assigns it to a SharedFD object, closing the raw file descriptor if successful.

methods.name: SharedFDFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag object that sets a SharedFD using a provided SharedFD reference.

methods.name: SharedFDFlag(const std::string&, SharedFD&)
methods.description: Creates a flag object with a specific name that sets a SharedFD using a provided SharedFD reference.
